_about: Voice direction for Chatterbox (scripts/make_voice_cb.py). One entry per script LINE (split=line). exag = emotion intensity, cfg = pacing (lower = slower), pause = silence after (s), say = spoken text, note = acting intention. Timbre: voice B (Kokoro bm_george reference, out/doomsday/vs/ref_bm_george.wav), kept from iteration 7.

lines.say: In nineteen sixty-one, two geniuses hid a computer in their shoes. To beat roulette.
lines.note: hook: storyteller, weight on 'in their shoes', a beat, then 'To beat roulette' sly
explainer leaning in, 'guess which slice' conspiratorial
gleeful and absurd, 'big toes' lands the gag

lines.say: In the basement test, it gave them a forty-four percent edge.

lines.note: triumph on 'It worked', then comic deflation on 'they quit'

lines.say: Thorp kept the secret for five years. Guinness now calls it the first wearable computer.

lines.note: 'But here's the real lesson' serious turn
clear teacher voice, slow on 'wipe you out'
wink to the viewer, 'check their shoes' sly
